cohort: 180 preterm neonates admitted to the Neonatal ICU, Department of Paediatrics, Civil Hospital, Ahmedabad, between September 1, 2014, and August 31, 2016.
finding: The most common cranial ultrasound finding was normal (69.44%), followed by normal variants (18.90%) and abnormal findings (11.66%), with intraventricular hemorrhage being the most common abnormality (8.3%).
followup_time: Variable, follow-up scans were performed on 70 of the 180 subjects.
